name: v28-25-curator-constant-review
objective: A19 deterministic browser plumbing: a constant auto-marked entry waits for explicit review, applies at a boundary only after approval, and rolls back on swipe. Real-model curator quality is deferred.

requires.why: Scripted curator/read; constant entry routing and author approval through the shipped runtime, no model calls.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so the message ids below would name the wrong line`); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

import_story.title: SO-A19 Curator Tiers
import_story.description: v2.7 02 C13 live row: a curator op into a protected span, and an auto-tier entry.

qualities.rubric: Has the party reached the gate?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().ready) throw new Error(`the story did not load: ${rt.getSnapshot().status}`); if (!SillyTavern.getContext().groupId) throw new Error('not a group chat'); return { cadence: 0, storyId: rt.getSnapshot().storyId };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const book = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-A19 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!book.ok && !String(book.message).includes('already exists')) throw new Error(`could not create the story lorebook: ${book.message}`); for (const [comment, keys] of [['The north gate', ['gate', 'warden']], ['The market square', ['market', 'square']]]) { const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-A19 Lore', comment, keys, content: 'placeholder', constant: true }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-A19 Lore'] } }); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error(`could not write ${comment}: ${entry.message}`); } const data = await ctx.loadWorldInfo('SO-A19 Lore'); const mark = (kind) => '{{' + '/'.repeat(2) + ' so:' + kind + '}}'; const texts = { 'The north gate': `The north gate is barred. ${mark('protect')}Only the warden carries the iron key.${mark('end')} Guards watch the road.`, 'The market square': `${mark('auto')}The market square is crowded at noon.` }; if (texts['The north gate'] !== "The north gate is barred. {{/" + "/ so:protect}}Only the warden carries the iron key.{{/" + "/ so:end}} Guards watch the road." || texts['The market square'] !== "{{/" + "/ so:auto}}The market square is crowded at noon.") throw new Error('the marker builder does not produce the documented markers'); for (const entry of Object.values(data?.entries ?? {})) if (texts[entry.comment]) entry.content = texts[entry.comment]; await wi.saveWorldInfo('SO-A19 Lore', data, true); const readBook = async () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const server = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-A19 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const byComment = (comment) => String(Object.values(server?.entries ?? {}).find((entry) => entry.comment === comment)?.content ?? ''); return { gate: byComment('The north gate'), market: byComment('The market square') }; }; const now = await readBook(); if (now.gate !== texts['The north gate'] || now.market !== texts['The market square']) throw new Error(`the marked entries did not reach the server: ${JSON.stringify(now)}`); globalThis.__a19 = { original: now, settings: rt.getStagecraftState().settings }; rt.setStagecraftSettings({ curatorEnabled: true, acceptMode: 'auto' }); const settings = rt.getStagecraftState().settings; if (!settings.curatorEnabled || settings.acceptMode !== 'auto') throw new Error(`the curator settings did not stick: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); return { original: now, acceptMode: settings.acceptMode };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugCuratorResponse = 'NONE'; const state = rt.getStagecraftState(); const record = (state.proposals ?? []).slice(-1)[0]; if (!record) throw new Error('the curator pass made no proposal'); const ops = record.ops.map((entry) => ({ kind: entry.op.kind, comment: entry.op.comment, status: entry.status })); if (ops.some((op) => op.comment === 'The north gate')) throw new Error(`an op into the protected span reached the card: ${JSON.stringify(ops)}`); const market = ops.find((op) => op.comment === 'The market square'); if (!market || market.status !== 'pending') throw new Error(`the constant auto-tier op did not wait for review: ${JSON.stringify(ops)}`); if (!JSON.stringify(state).includes('touches protected text')) throw new Error(`the refusal is not recorded: ${JSON.stringify(state.lastPass ?? null).slice(0, 600)}`); const readBook = async () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const server = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-A19 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const byComment = (comment) => String(Object.values(server?.entries ?? {}).find((entry) => entry.comment === comment)?.content ?? ''); return { gate: byComment('The north gate'), market: byComment('The market square') }; }; const now = await readBook(); if (now.market !== globalThis.__a19.original.market) throw new Error('the accepted op was written before a boundary'); globalThis.__a19.record = record.id; await rt.applyCuratorProposals(); const unchanged = await readBook(); if (unchanged.market !== now.market) throw new Error('constant entry written before author approval'); await rt.setCuratorOpDecision(record.id, record.ops.findIndex((entry) => entry.op.comment === 'The market square'), 'accepted'); return { ops, dropped: state.lastPass?.dropped ?? null };

steps.eval: const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`timed out after ${ms} ms: ${what}`); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const readBook = async () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const server = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-A19 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const byComment = (comment) => String(Object.values(server?.entries ?? {}).find((entry) => entry.comment === comment)?.content ?? ''); return { gate: byComment('The north gate'), market: byComment('The market square') }; }; const now = await until(async () => { const read = await readBook(); return read.market.includes('empty at dusk') ? read : null; }, 10000, 'the boundary to write the accepted auto-tier op'); if (now.gate !== globalThis.__a19.original.gate) throw new Error(`the protected entry changed: ${now.gate}`); const applied = rt.getStagecraftState().proposals.flatMap((record) => record.ops).filter((entry) => entry.status === 'applied'); if (!applied.length) throw new Error('the ring holds no applied op'); return { market: now.market, applied: applied.length };

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const reply = ctx.chat[ctx.chat.length - 1]; if (!reply || reply.is_user || reply.name !== 'Arin') throw new Error(`the newest message is not Arin's reply: ${JSON.stringify(reply && { name: reply.name, is_user: reply.is_user })}`); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'The gate is grey and silent in the rain.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipes: reply.swipes.length };

''); return { gate: byComment('The north gate'), market: byComment('The market square') }; }; const now = await until(async () => { const read = await readBook(); return read.market === globalThis.__a19.original.market ? read : null; }, 15000, 'the swipe to revert the applied op to its before-image'); if (now.gate !== globalThis.__a19.original.gate) throw new Error(`the protected entry changed: ${now.gate}`); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== 'road') throw new Error(`the swipe did not roll the story back to the road: ${rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId}`); return { market: now.market, checkpoint: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId };
